card.body: <!-- sprint-meta risk=R2 spec=2026-09-10-roles-and-souls spec_sha256=deadbeef area=maintenance slug=t_3a4b5c6d -->

args.text: assumptions: round-3 escalation continues from the three approaches Sonnet 5 already tried

args.reason:
BLOCKER: a fourth approach tried under Opus 5 still does not make the wrapper idempotent under FakeSh replay
TRIED: 1) memoizing on argv tuple; 2) a per-call nonce; 3) wrapping at the call site; 4) hashing the full call including timeout, which changes FakeSh's script-matching contract
NEED: a decision on whether FakeSh needs a nonce channel added, or the wrapper moves up a layer
